title: Pomodoro Timer
description: 25-minute focus + 5-minute break pomodoro timer. PM produces PRD, UI produces style guide, Frontend implements with timer logic, Reviewer checks.
userPrompt: 帮我做一个番茄时钟 Web App。React + TypeScript，经典 Pomodoro 模式：25分钟专注 + 5分钟短休息，每4个番茄后15分钟长休息。番茄红色调，环形进度条，开始/暂停/重置按钮。
successCriteria: UI reads PRD and creates style guide
Frontend reads PRD and style guide
Frontend creates web_app artifact with timer logic
